skill.name: seedance-2-5-image-to-video
skill.description: Animate one still image into a 4-30 second 720p Seedance 2.5 video through RunComfy. Control motion, duration, and optional synchronized audio.
skill.summary: Create 720p Seedance 2.5 videos from still images with optional native audio.
skill.author: genmedia-labs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, documentation links, placeholder URLs, and a documented owner-only token path. The skill does intentionally send the prompt and image URL to RunComfy, creating a disclosed low-severity third-party data transfer risk.

remediation.issue: Prompts and image URLs are transmitted to the RunComfy model API.
remediation.suggestion: Request user confirmation before sending sensitive media, and reject image URLs that contain credentials or private access tokens.

content.value_statement: Static images cannot show motion, camera movement, or synchronized sound. This skill creates directed 720p clips from one image through Seedance 2.5.
actual_capabilities: Generates a 4-30 second 720p video from one publicly reachable image URL.
Directs subject movement and camera movement through a natural-language prompt.
Generates synchronized speech, sound effects, and music when audio is enabled.
Creates silent clips by disabling the generate_audio option.
Downloads completed RunComfy outputs into a selected local directory.
Explains when to use related 480p, text, reference, or first-and-last-frame models.
limitations: Output resolution is fixed at 720p on this endpoint.
The output aspect ratio follows the input image and cannot be selected separately.
Each request accepts one image and supports durations from 4 to 30 whole seconds.
Results are not reproducible by seed, and audio timing may require repeated generations.

use_cases.title: Animate Product Photography
use_cases.description: Add controlled product motion and camera movement while preserving the approved source composition.

use_cases.title: Create Social Video Variants
use_cases.description: Generate several short motion treatments from one campaign image for social channels.

use_cases.title: Preview Shot Movement
use_cases.description: Test camera and subject motion from a storyboard frame before planning production.

prompt_templates.title: Add Simple Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [image URL] for [duration] seconds. The subject [movement]. Use a [camera movement] and keep the scene consistent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first animation from one still image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Silent Product Shot
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [product image URL] into a silent [duration]-second clip. Show [product motion] with [camera direction]. Add no text or watermark.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a clean product visual without generated audio.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Talking Portrait
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [portrait URL] for [duration] seconds. The person says, "[dialogue]." Use [delivery], [camera movement], and [ambient sound].
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate speech and ambience in the same video pass.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Structured Long Take
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second continuous shot from [image URL]. Begin with [opening], develop through [middle], and end with [closing]. Include [audio plan].
prompt_templates.scenario: Define a longer clip with clear narrative progression.

output_examples.input: Animate a bottle photograph for eight seconds with a slow turn, gentle push-in, and no audio.
output_examples.output: A completed 720p silent clip is downloaded, preserving the source aspect ratio while adding the requested product and camera motion.

output_examples.input: Animate a cafe portrait for six seconds with one spoken sentence and quiet room ambience.
output_examples.output: A completed 720p clip includes facial movement, the requested dialogue, synchronized ambience, and a restrained camera drift.

output_examples.input: Create a 20-second scene with an opening action, a middle camera move, and a defined final pose.
output_examples.output: A continuous 720p shot follows the staged progression and downloads to the selected output directory.

best_practices: Describe subject motion and camera motion in separate clauses.
Use the source image for stable appearance details and reserve the prompt for changes.
Name each speaker, sound effect, and ambience source when generated audio is enabled.
anti_patterns: Do not request a new aspect ratio in the prompt; crop the source image first.
Do not introduce absent characters through text; use a multi-reference model instead.
Do not combine contradictory camera directions or change many variables between iterations.

faq.question: What image formats are supported?
faq.answer: The endpoint accepts publicly reachable JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, and GIF image URLs.

faq.question: Can I choose the output aspect ratio?
faq.answer: No. The output follows the input image aspect ratio, so prepare the source crop before generation.

faq.question: What durations can I generate?
faq.answer: Choose any whole-second duration from 4 through 30 seconds. The default is 5 seconds.

faq.question: Can the video include audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The model can generate synchronized speech, sound effects, and music, or create a silent clip.

faq.question: Can I use more than one reference image?
faq.answer: No. This endpoint accepts one image. Use Seedance Reference-to-Video when several references are required.

faq.question: Where are completed videos saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads completed output files into the local directory selected for the request.
